mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.name, e.gender, e.age, e.phone, e.email, e.position_id, p.position_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.id ORDER BY e.name
SELECT e.id, e.name, e.gender, e.age, e.phone, e.email, e.position_id, p.position_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
SELECT e.id, e.name, e.gender, e.age, e.phone, e.email, e.position_id, p.position_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.name LIKE #{namePattern} ORDER BY e.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees (name, gender, age, phone, email, position_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{positionId})
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, position_id = #{positionId} WHERE id = #{id}
